How to get a free key

No key yet? It\'s free: sign up on opensubtitles.com, open API consumers (opensubtitles.com/en/consumers), choose New consumer, name it (VLC Redesign) and copy its API key here. Your account\'s username and password raise how many subtitles you can download a day.
